text: わたし　すぐ　あたまに　ちが　のぼっちゃう　のよ　しんこきゅう　しよ…　すー　はー

structure.jp: わたし　すぐ　あたまに　ちが　のぼっちゃう　のよ
structure.en: I lose my temper so easily, you see

structure.jp: しんこきゅう　しよ…
structure.en: let me take a deep breath...

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is the casual short form of てしまう, which says something happens all the way, often when you wish it didn't. のぼっちゃう = 'ends up rushing up'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.span: のぼっちゃう　のよ
patterns.explanation: の at the end gives the feeling of explaining yourself; のよ is the soft, feminine way of saying it. のぼっちゃう　のよ = 'it rushes up, you see'.

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: The よう ending means 'let's' or 'I think I'll'; しよ is しよう cut short in casual speech. しんこきゅう　しよ = 'let me take a deep breath'.
